Shopify B2B Development

Shopify B2B & Wholesale Solutions

Shopify B2B wholesale solutions are the technical foundation that lets brands sell to trade customers directly through Shopify — with the pricing complexity, ordering workflows and account management that trade relationships require. Shopify B2B solutions, Shopify B2B store setup and wholesale ecommerce solutions on Shopify require more than toggling the B2B switch — they require custom Shopify wholesale development that handles the full complexity of trade operations. Running wholesale operations on Shopify requires more than flipping a switch. Sophisticated trade relationships need customer-group pricing, bulk order interfaces, net payment terms, account approval workflows and deep ERP integration — all in a system that your wholesale buyers find easy to use. We've built it across distribution, manufacturing, wholesale fashion and trade supply businesses. The result: faster ordering, fewer support calls, and more wholesale revenue.

Why it matters

A store engineered to convert — not just to look good.

If you're an ambitious ecommerce brand, shopify b2b & wholesale solutions should compound revenue at every visit. Here's what we help you achieve:

  • Lift conversion rate across mobile and desktop.

What's included

Everything you get with Shopify B2B & Wholesale Solutions.

01

Customer group pricing tiers

Account-level pricing with volume breaks, minimum order quantities and customer-group-specific product catalogs — configured in Shopify Plus or via custom app for non-Plus stores.

02

Bulk order forms

Custom wholesale order interfaces designed for buyers placing large, multi-SKU orders — reducing friction, minimizing errors and eliminating the phone and email orders that eat your team's time.

03

Net terms & trade invoicing

Net 30/60/90 payment terms with automated invoice generation, outstanding balance tracking and overdue payment notifications — integrated with your accounting system.

04

Trade account registration & approval

Custom trade account application forms with admin approval routing, document upload, status notifications and sales rep assignment — replacing manual email-based account onboarding.

05

Shopify Plus B2B features

Full implementation of Shopify Plus's native B2B module — company accounts, multiple ship-to locations, payment terms and B2B-specific checkout experiences.

06

ERP & inventory integration

Real-time inventory sync and order data flow between Shopify and your ERP, WMS or accounting platform — via Shopify API, webhooks or middleware depending on your systems.

How it works

A clear path from audit to growth.

Step 01

Discover

Understanding your wholesale operation — buyer types, pricing structure, order workflows, current pain points and integration requirements.

Step 02

Design

B2B customer journey mapping, order form UX design and technical architecture for pricing and account management systems.

Step 03

Build

Development, integration testing and end-to-end workflow testing with real buyer scenarios.

Step 04

Launch

Internal training, wholesale buyer communication and post-launch support as your team and buyers adapt to the new system.

Good to know.

Shopify Plus gives you the most robust native B2B features and is recommended for high-volume Shopify B2B wholesale solutions. For smaller wholesale setups, we can build effective B2B solutions on standard Shopify using custom pricing apps and custom account management. We'll recommend the right approach for your scale.

Yes. Our Shopify B2B wholesale solutions integrate with NetSuite, SAP, Sage, Brightpearl, QuickBooks and custom ERPs. Integration scope depends on your ERP's API and what data needs to flow in both directions.

Yes — this is a common setup. B2B buyers see their account pricing and bulk interfaces; DTC buyers see the standard storefront. Shopify Plus makes this cleanest with dedicated B2B storefronts, but it's achievable on standard Shopify with the right architecture.
